title: M.B. Abu Salih
text:
Bio
I am Muhammad Badr ABU SALIH, a researcher in political science, and a former lecturer at the University of Aleppo, Faculty of Arts and Humanities.
I specialize in comparative politics, mainly on democracy and democratization, with a focus on the Middle East.
I got my MA in Political Science and International Relations from Altınbaş University in Istanbul, with a thesis titled “Misdirected by The Successes of The Others: The Case of Syria in The Arab Spring”.
I am committed to engaging in more puzzles, conducting rigorous research, and sharing ideas in the field, with the aim of contributing to our collective knowledge to strengthen democracy around the world.


Interests

Comparative Politics
Democracy and Democratization
Authoritarianism
Computational Social Science
